description: Estimate generated minutes and launch credits before submitting PDF narration. English-only launch: PDF files up to 10 MiB, selected narration up to 20 pages, 18,000 characters, or 20 generated minutes, and one active audio job per account. MP3/M4B cost 15 credits per generated minute; MP4 costs 20 credits per generated minute. Free and local-only.

characters.description: Known narration character count, if already extracted.

minutes.description: Known generated minutes, if already estimated.

path.description: Absolute path to a PDF file. Used for a rough size-based duration estimate.

target_language.description: Only set when mode is translate. Leave empty for English speech/audiobook/presentation estimates.

name: exactpdf_estimate_speech_cost
